messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: high 5xx rate observed on runtime cluster (us-west-2). Percent errors jumped from 0.3% -> 12% at ~2024-11-04T22:28:20Z. Auto-escalation to primary oncall. :rotating_light:

maria: oncall here. I’m looking. Any impact to hosted API or dedicated customers?

ben: seeing increased 503/504s on model-forwarder and batch router.  p50 latency up ~3x. Root tracepoints show KV cache misses exploding.

alice: adding logs: https://internal-logs.redwood/v/streams/rt-cluster?id=cluster-west&from=2024-11-04T22:25Z

sam: noticing a pattern: spikes align with a small burst of long-context requests from a single org (org-942). Could be cache thrash.

maria: hypothesis 1: prefix KV eviction under heavy long-context tail -> cache thrash -> upstream timeouts. Hypothesis 2: kernel mismatch from recent rollout to runtime-1.14. Need timeline.

ben: pulling deploy timeline now. One deployment to runtime-1.14 in us-west-2 at 2024-11-04T21:45Z (rollout A/B), none after.

ben: logs (snippet):
```
2024-11-04T22:28:21.112Z router ERROR request_id=abc123 kv_cache_miss seq=2048 cost_ms=321 timeout=1000
2024-11-04T22:28:21.113Z forwarder WARN request_id=abc123 upstream_timeout=1005
```

maria: ok. Can someone collect per-node KV cache hit ratios for the 22:20-22:35 window? That'll help decide eviction/tuning vs rollback.

alice: exporting metrics dashboard -> https://metrics.redwood/d/kv/cluster-west?from=2024-11-04T22:15Z&to=2024-11-04T22:40Z

raj: support: we already received 3 customer reports (PS queues) indicating generation timeouts and retries. Two are dedicated customers; flagging for account leads.

emily: I can draft a short status page. Proposed blurb: "We are investigating increased error rates impacting text-generation endpoints in us-west-2. Engineers are actively mitigating; some requests may see timeouts or retries. Next update in 30 minutes." Thoughts?

maria: good start. Add note: "We have a mitigation in progress and will provide impact scope soon." Also call out impacted timeframe once confirmed.

sam: quick mitigation attempt: temporarily reduce KV eviction aggressiveness and enable conservative batching for affected nodes. Pushing config change to the canary subset now (canary node ids: canary-7, canary-9).

ben: ran config change on canary -> observed reduced 5xx on those nodes within ~90s. p95 latency decreased. Rolling to 25% nodes now.

incident-bot: action assigned -> maria (incident commander), ben (engineer), emily (comms), raj (support lead).

maria: good. Ben keep metrics and logs pinned. Emily please prepare status page and customer email draft. Raj, collect list of impacted customers with severity.

emily: statuspage draft: 

"We are investigating elevated error rates in the text-generation service in the US-WEST-2 region. Engineers have identified cache thrashing correlated with long-context requests from a subset of traffic and are performing targeted mitigations. Some customers may experience delays or transient failures. We will provide another update within 30 minutes or earlier if there is a substantive change."

maria: edit: add timeline bullet placeholders: 
- detection: 2024-11-04T22:28Z
- initial mitigation (canary): 2024-11-04T22:33Z
- partial roll: 2024-11-04T22:36Z

sam: collecting per-org request rate for that window to identify noisy tenants. Will post CSV shortly.

ben: posting quick test queries to confirm behavior. If mitigation continues, we can continue gradual rollout and avoid full rollback. Still need to confirm if runtime-1.14 changes affected cache eviction heuristics though.

alice: uploaded compressed logs for 22:20-22:40 -> s3://redwood-uploads/incidents/1805678901/rt-22-20-22-40.tar.gz

raj: support notes: notifying TAMs of dedicated customers. Also prepping customer-facing summary for org-942 specifically if they ask.

maria: timeline-building task: Ben, please add a short timeline snippet to the incident doc with exact node ids and metric deltas. Sam, attach per-org CSV. Alice, ensure logs are accessible to oncall rotation.

ben: done — timeline draft: 
- 21:45Z: runtime-1.14 rollout (A/B)
- 22:28Z: spike detection alert (5xx > 10%)
- 22:33Z: canary config tweak (reduced eviction aggressiveness) -> canary nodes p95 improved
- 22:36Z: roll to 25% nodes; global error rate trending down

emily: status page updated and posted: https://status.redwood/incident/2024-11-04/kv-thrash. Draft customer email in thread: "We observed elevated error rates between ~22:28-22:50 UTC impacting generation endpoints in us-west-2. Mitigations applied reduced error rate; we are monitoring for stabilization."

maria: excellent. Next: handoff planning — my shift ends in 40m. If we still have open mitigations at 23:10Z, please escalate to @ben (secondary oncall).

ben: I’ll be ready to take over. Also suggest a short post-incident runbook: consider reverting recent eviction heuristic changes if we see recurrence during load tests.

sam: noting a coverage gap: alerts didn’t correlate per-org long-context tail automatically — we should add that to followup action items.

maria: agreed. Tagging followups: alerting rule for KV-miss tail detection, add canary test with long-context synthetic traffic, postmortem owner: ben. Emily will draft external comms post-incident.

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigation in progress. Severity: Sev-2. Next update scheduled in 25 minutes.

maria: closing loop for now — everyone add any missing logs/timestamps to the incident doc. If error rate re-spikes, ping on this thread and escalate immediately. :thumbsup:
